project.description: Packages the logging image from the per-stack reactor lane and ships the tarball to the stack's S3 prefix. Requires a prior successful 'PIC-SURE Maven Build' for the same TARGET_STACK. Converted from services/pic-sure-logging/jenkinsfile.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail
: "${TARGET_STACK:?TARGET_STACK is required}" : "${S3_BUCKET_NAME:?S3_BUCKET_NAME is required}"
MAVEN_WS="/var/jenkins_home/workspace/PIC-SURE Maven Build - ${TARGET_STACK}" MODULE="services/pic-sure-logging" STAMP="$MAVEN_WS/build-info/$(printf '%s' "$MODULE" | tr '/' '_').txt"
# Guard: this job does not compile. It needs this module's own jar plus the stamp written # for this module, so a lane whose last build targeted a different module cannot mislabel # this image with a commit that never built this jar. if [ ! -f "$STAMP" ] || ! ls "$MAVEN_WS/$MODULE"/target/pic-sure-logging-*.jar >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: no current artifacts for $MODULE on stack ${TARGET_STACK} -- run 'PIC-SURE Maven Build' with MODULES=$MODULE first" exit 2 fi . "$STAMP"
docker build --load \ -t "hms-dbmi/pic-sure-logging:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" \ "$MAVEN_WS/services/pic-sure-logging/"
docker save "hms-dbmi/pic-sure-logging:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" | gzip > pic-sure-logging.tar.gz aws s3 --sse=AES256 cp pic-sure-logging.tar.gz "s3://$S3_BUCKET_NAME/$TARGET_STACK/containers/pic-sure-logging.tar.gz"
